reference.authors: Giacomo Indiveri, Fabio Stefanini, and Elisabetta Chicca
reference.title: Spike-based learning with a generalized integrate and fire silicon neuron
reference.source_scope: equations (2)-(3), together with the circuit description of threshold feedback, reset, refractory pulse, and spike-driven adaptation

numerical_specialization.reset: an event loads refractory_period and i_reset; subsequent r(t)=1 steps hold i_mem at i_reset while advancing adaptation
numerical_specialization.sample_contract: post-step i_mem, i_ahp, refractory_time, and binary event
numerical_specialization.maintained_boundary: The dimensionless defaults, input split, timestep, discrete integration, event ordering, and refractory counter are maintained SC-NeuroCore choices; the paper does not print this discrete recurrence or these normalized values.

identity_boundary.implemented: the coupled current-mode membrane, positive-feedback, and adaptation DPI equations under the maintained numerical specialization
identity_boundary.not_claimed: transistor-level mismatch, measured chip timing or power, PPA, device noise, board or HIL validation, physical-silicon equivalence, or the paper's complete learning system
identity_boundary.catalogue_identity: DPINeuron is the DPI circuit model; no duplicate SC-prefixed catalogue variant is introduced or removed.
